answer: One artifact per identity blocks fakes: a newcomer registers a cedar timber sample, grain hashed, with a refundable 40 bond. Each artifact needs a new grove, so the k-th fake costs 100+8(k-1): 40 plus 60 to cut and ship one, farther groves cost more. Filings from the tundra need in-person presentation. Rented artifacts share a grain hash, burning both bonds. 1,000 fakes cost 4,096,000 vs a 40,000 pool; honest agents file once, keep their share.
